name: Kirjath Jearim
overview: Kirjath Jearim, also known as Baalah, is closely connected to the Gibeonites, who cunningly secured a covenant with Israel by presenting themselves as distant ambassadors with worn-out provisions (Joshua 9:3-8). This city lies within the territory allotted to Judah and played a significant role in the history of the ark of the covenant, which was brought there by the Philistines and remained for twenty years before King David brought it back. The inhabitants of Kirjath Jearim were spared destruction due to the covenant with the Gibeonites but were placed under servitude, highlighting God's faithfulness to His promises and the importance of covenant relationships in Israel's history.
